description: Legacy clients: two call workflow; get ride (total only) then GET fare-items; expect total matches breakdown sum.
Optimized: single call includeFareBreakdown=true should return breakdown inline and reconcile totals.
Simulated high-latency network: baseline suffers 2 round trips; optimized single round trip should show latency reduction.
Payloads with malformed rideId (non-string or invalid format) should return 4xx error and not crash services.
Ride has fare item with malicious label or nested arrays; system should sanitize and normalize into safe string and normalized breakdown.
